title: Wholesome Keto Polish Serrano Ham Meal-Prep
description: A flavorful and keto-friendly Polish-inspired meal-prep dish featuring serrano ham in a floral glaze, served in agave leaves.
instructions: Place 4 agave leaves on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Divide the serrano ham among the agave leaves.
In a small bowl, mix together 2 tbsp of almond flour, 1 tsp of garlic powder, and 1 tsp of dried thyme.
Evenly sprinkle the almond flour mixture over the serrano ham.
Drizzle 1 tbsp of glaze (see below) over the serrano ham.
Fold the agave leaves over the filling to create a package.
Bake for 15 minutes, or until the agave leaves are crispy and the ham is heated through.
